welcome_page.title: E-scooter – Personal security
welcome_page.description:
Lighting and how secure you feel from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter after dark, does poor street lighting change your route or when you ride?

options.text: No, it makes no difference to me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I ride slower or keep to better-lit roads
I take a much longer, better-lit route
I don't ride after dark because of poor lighting
I don't ride after dark for other reasons

questions.text: During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)
In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter?
When you feel unsafe in the evening, what do you change?
questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: I share my location with someone
I ask someone to come with me
I use a different means of transport

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Few cues to find my way without sight (e.g. no tactile paths or audio announcements)

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico dopo il buio, la scarsa illuminazione delle strade cambia il tuo percorso o gli orari in cui vai?
it.#No, it makes no difference to me: No, per me non fa differenza
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Vado più piano o resto sulle strade più illuminate
it.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Faccio un percorso molto più lungo ma meglio illuminato
it.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Non vado dopo il buio per la scarsa illuminazione
it.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: Non vado dopo il buio per altri motivi
it.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: Durante il giorno, ti è mai capitato di sentirti in pericolo per criminalità o molestie quando vai in monopattino elettrico? (Le molestie comprendono commenti indesiderati, pedinamenti, contatti fisici o comportamenti intimidatori rivolti a te.)
it.#In the evening or after dark, do you ev: La sera o dopo il buio, ti è mai capitato di sentirti in pericolo per criminalità o molestie quando vai in monopattino elettrico?
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, have you ex: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, hai subito o temi molestie per come sei o per il tuo aspetto (ad es. genere, aspetto fisico, origine, età)?
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, what makes: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, cosa ti fa sentire meno al sicuro da reati o molestie? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Places with few people around (isolated: Luoghi con poca gente (zone isolate o deserte)
it.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: Persone che si comportano in modo aggressivo o intimidatorio
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Scarsa manutenzione (es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture rotte)
it.#No surveillance or security measures (e: Mancanza di sorveglianza o di misure di sicurezza (es. niente telecamere, niente personale)
it.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: Episodi accaduti a me o segnalati nella zona
it.#Few cues to find my way without sight (: Pochi riferimenti per orientarmi senza vista (es. niente percorsi tattili o annunci sonori)
it.#When you feel unsafe in the evening, wh: Quando la sera non ti senti al sicuro, cosa cambi?
Puoi scegliere più di una risposta.
it.#I share my location with someone: Condivido la mia posizione con qualcuno
it.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
Illuminazione e quanto ti senti al sicuro da criminalità o molestie quando vai in monopattino elettrico.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

Solo il gruppo di ricerca SmartUrbanity legge le tue risposte. Le conserviamo per la ricerca per 36 mesi; poi le cancelliamo o le rendiamo anonime.

fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique à la tombée de la nuit, un mauvais éclairage des rues change-t-il votre trajet ou vos horaires ?
fr.#No, it makes no difference to me: Non, cela ne fait aucune différence pour moi
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Je roule plus lentement ou je reste sur les routes mieux éclairées
fr.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Je fais un trajet beaucoup plus long, mais mieux éclairé
fr.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Je ne roule pas après la tombée de la nuit à cause du mauvais éclairage
fr.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: Je ne roule pas après la tombée de la nuit pour d’autres raisons
fr.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: En journée, vous arrive-t-il de vous sentir en danger à cause de la délinquance ou du harcèlement lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique ? (Le harcèlement comprend les remarques non désirées, la filature, les contacts physiques ou les comportements intimidants envers vous.)
fr.#In the evening or after dark, do you ev: Le soir ou après la tombée de la nuit, vous arrive-t-il de vous sentir en danger à cause de la délinquance ou du harcèlement lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, have you ex: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, avez-vous subi ou craignez-vous du harcèlement en raison de ce que vous êtes ou de votre apparence (par ex. genre, apparence, origine, âge) ?
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what makes: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, qu’est-ce qui vous fait vous sentir moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Places with few people around (isolated: Les lieux où il y a peu de monde (zones isolées ou désertes)
fr.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: Des personnes qui se comportent de façon agressive ou intimidante
fr.#Blind corners or obstructed views: Les angles morts ou les vues obstruées
fr.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Un mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures dégradées)
fr.#No surveillance or security measures (e: L’absence de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméras, pas de personnel)
fr.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: Des incidents qui me sont arrivés ou qui ont été signalés dans le quartier
fr.#Few cues to find my way without sight (: Peu de repères pour m’orienter sans la vue (par ex. pas de bandes podotactiles ni d’annonces sonores)
fr.#When you feel unsafe in the evening, wh: Quand vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité le soir, que changez-vous ?
fr.#I share my location with someone: Je partage ma position avec quelqu’un
fr.#I use a different means of transport: Je prends un autre moyen de transport
fr.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
Éclairage et sentiment de sécurité face à la délinquance ou au harcèlement lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

Seule l’équipe de recherche SmartUrbanity lit vos réponses. Nous les conservons pour la recherche pendant 36 mois, puis nous les supprimons ou les rendons anonymes.

de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Verändert schlechte Straßenbeleuchtung Ihre Route oder den Zeitpunkt, wenn Sie nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit E-Scooter fahren?
de.#No, it makes no difference to me: Nein, das macht für mich keinen Unterschied
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Ich fahre langsamer oder bleibe auf besser beleuchteten Straßen
de.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Ich nehme eine viel längere, aber besser beleuchtete Strecke
de.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Ich fahre nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht wegen der schlechten Beleuchtung
de.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: Ich fahre nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit aus anderen Gründen nicht
de.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: Fühlen Sie sich tagsüber beim E-Scooter-Fahren manchmal durch Kriminalität oder Belästigung unsicher? (Zu Belästigung zählen unerwünschte Bemerkungen, Verfolgen, Berühren oder einschüchterndes Verhalten, das gegen Sie gerichtet ist.)
de.#In the evening or after dark, do you ev: Fühlen Sie sich abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit beim E-Scooter-Fahren manchmal durch Kriminalität oder Belästigung unsicher?
de.#When you ride an e-scooter, have you ex: Haben Sie beim E-Scooter-Fahren Belästigung wegen Ihrer Person oder Ihres Aussehens (z. B. Geschlecht, Erscheinungsbild, Herkunft, Alter) erlebt oder befürchten Sie diese?
de.#When you ride an e-scooter, what makes: Was gibt Ihnen beim E-Scooter-Fahren ein geringeres Sicherheitsgefühl vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Places with few people around (isolated: Orte, an denen wenige Menschen sind (abgelegene oder menschenleere Gegenden)
de.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: Menschen, die sich aggressiv oder einschüchternd verhalten
de.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Schlechte Instandhaltung (z. B. verlassene Gebäude, Graffiti, kaputte Infrastruktur)
de.#No surveillance or security measures (e: Fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal)
de.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: Vorfälle, die mir passiert sind oder in der Gegend gemeldet wurden
de.#Few cues to find my way without sight (: Wenig Orientierungshilfen ohne Sehen (z. B. keine Blindenleitsysteme oder Durchsagen)
de.#When you feel unsafe in the evening, wh: Wenn Sie sich abends nicht sicher fühlen, was ändern Sie?
de.#I share my location with someone: Ich teile meinen Standort mit jemandem
de.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
Beleuchtung und wie sicher Sie sich vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung fühlen, wenn Sie E-Scooter fahren.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft und an keine Behörde weitergegeben.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

Nur das SmartUrbanity-Forschungsteam liest Ihre Antworten. Wir speichern sie 36 Monate lang für die Forschung; danach löschen oder anonymisieren wir sie.

tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Karanlıkta elektrikli scooter kullanırken yetersiz sokak aydınlatması güzergâhınızı veya ne zaman scooter kullandığınızı değiştiriyor mu?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Daha yavaş sürerim veya daha iyi aydınlatılmış yollarda kalırım
tr.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Çok daha uzun ama daha iyi aydınlatılmış bir güzergâh seçerim
tr.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Yetersiz aydınlatma nedeniyle karanlıkta scooter kullanmam
tr.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: Gündüz elektrikli scooter kullanırken suç veya taciz nedeniyle kendinizi güvensiz hissettiğiniz oluyor mu? (Taciz; istenmeyen sözleri, takip edilmeyi, dokunulmayı veya size yönelik yıldırıcı davranışları kapsar.)
tr.#In the evening or after dark, do you ev: Akşam ya da karanlıkta elektrikli scooter kullanırken suç veya taciz nedeniyle kendinizi güvensiz hissettiğiniz oluyor mu?
tr.#When you ride an e-scooter, have you ex: Elektrikli scooter kullanırken kim olduğunuz veya görünüşünüz nedeniyle (örn. cinsiyet, görünüm, köken, yaş) taciz yaşadınız mı ya da bundan korkuyor musunuz?
tr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what makes: Elektrikli scooter kullanırken neler kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı daha az güvende hissetmenize neden oluyor? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Places with few people around (isolated: Etrafta az insan olan yerler (ıssız veya tenha alanlar)
tr.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: Saldırgan veya gözdağı verici davranan insanlar
tr.#Blind corners or obstructed views: Kör köşeler veya kapalı görüş alanları
tr.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Bakımsızlık (örn. terk edilmiş binalar, grafitiler, bozuk altyapı)
tr.#No surveillance or security measures (e: Gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin eksikliği (örn. kamera yok, görevli yok)
tr.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: Başıma gelen veya bölgede bildirilen olaylar
tr.#Few cues to find my way without sight (: Görmeden yolumu bulmak için az ipucu olması (örn. hissedilebilir yüzey veya sesli anons yok)
tr.#When you feel unsafe in the evening, wh: Akşamları kendinizi güvende hissetmediğinizde neyi değiştiriyorsunuz?
tr.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
Aydınlatma ve elektrikli scooter kullanırken suça veya tacize karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissettiğiniz.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

Yanıtlarınızı yalnızca SmartUrbanity araştırma ekibi okur. Yanıtlarınızı araştırma amacıyla 36 ay saklarız; ardından siler veya anonim hâle getiririz.

fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی بعد از تاریک شدن هوا، آیا روشنایی ضعیف خیابان مسیر یا زمان رفتن شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: آهسته‌تر می‌روم یا در خیابان‌های روشن‌تر می‌مانم
fa.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: مسیر خیلی طولانی‌تر اما روشن‌تر را انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: به دلیل روشنایی ضعیف بعد از تاریکی اسکوترسوار نمی‌شوم
fa.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: به دلایل دیگر بعد از تاریکی اسکوترسوار نمی‌شوم
fa.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: آیا در طول روز هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی پیش می‌آید که به‌خاطر جرم یا آزار احساس ناامنی کنید؟ (آزار شامل حرف‌های ناخواسته، تعقیب شدن، لمس شدن یا رفتار تهدیدآمیز نسبت به شماست.)
fa.#In the evening or after dark, do you ev: آیا در شب یا بعد از تاریک شدن هوا، هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی پیش می‌آید که به‌خاطر جرم یا آزار احساس ناامنی کنید؟
fa.#When you ride an e-scooter, have you ex: هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی، آیا به دلیل ویژگی‌های شخصی یا ظاهرتان (مثلاً جنسیت، ظاهر، خاستگاه، سن) آزار دیده‌اید یا از آن می‌ترسید؟
fa.#When you ride an e-scooter, what makes: هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی، چه چیزهایی باعث می‌شوند در برابر جرم یا آزار کمتر احساس امنیت کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Places with few people around (isolated: مکان‌هایی با رفت‌وآمد کم (مناطق دورافتاده یا خلوت)
fa.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: افرادی که رفتار پرخاشگرانه یا ترساننده دارند
fa.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: نگهداری ضعیف (مثلاً ساختمان‌های متروکه، گرافیتی، زیرساخت‌های خراب)
fa.#No surveillance or security measures (e: نبود نظارت یا اقدامات امنیتی (مثلاً بدون دوربین، بدون کارکنان)
fa.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: حوادثی که برای من رخ داده یا در منطقه گزارش شده است
fa.#Few cues to find my way without sight (: نشانه‌های کم برای مسیریابی بدون دیدن (مثلاً نبود مسیر لمسی یا اعلام صوتی)
fa.#When you feel unsafe in the evening, wh: وقتی عصر احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید، چه چیزی را تغییر می‌دهید؟
می‌توانید بیش از یک پاسخ انتخاب کنید.
fa.#I share my location with someone: موقعیت مکانی‌ام را با کسی به اشتراک می‌گذارم
fa.#I use a different means of transport: از وسیله نقلیه دیگری استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
روشنایی و اینکه هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید.

شرکت داوطلبانه است و می‌توانید به هر پرسشی پاسخ ندهید. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند و به هیچ نهاد دولتی فرستاده نمی‌شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید

فقط گروه پژوهشی SmartUrbanity پاسخ‌های شما را می‌خواند. آن‌ها را برای پژوهش به مدت ۳۶ ماه نگه می‌داریم؛ سپس حذف یا ناشناس می‌کنیم.

hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Ha sötétedés után rollerezik, a rossz utcai világítás megváltoztatja az útvonalát vagy azt, hogy mikor rollerezik?
hu.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Lassabban megyek, vagy a jobban megvilágított utakon maradok
hu.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Sokkal hosszabb, de jobban megvilágított útvonalat választok
hu.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Sötétedés után nem rollerezem a rossz világítás miatt
hu.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: Sötétedés után más okból nem rollerezem
hu.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: Előfordul, hogy nappal elektromos rollerezés közben a bűncselekmények vagy a zaklatás miatt nem érzi magát biztonságban? (Zaklatás: nem kívánt megjegyzések, követés, megérintés vagy Ön ellen irányuló megfélemlítő viselkedés.)
